summary: The UTE vNext centre modules (A1/B/C). tsc never emits .mjs, and the glue imports every one of these by a relative specifier, so each must ride the byte-identical dist mirror or the shipped `files: ["dist"]` install face fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at the FIRST governed member bind - the GLUE-6 RED-A class, one layer deeper than the old rows.
note: ORDER: agent-bindings.mjs (the glue) is PLACEMENTS[0] and lives in 010; these are its runtime dependencies. admission.ts is genuinely TypeScript: tsc emits admission.js and admission-port.mjs therefore imports './admission.js' (source-tree runs resolve it through the test hooks ' .js -> .ts rewrite), so the .ts file is deliberately NOT copied here - placing it would drift from the compiled contract. Adding an .mjs under vnext/ without adding it here makes the built product unloadable while every source-tree test stays green, which is exactly the kind of gap this list exists to close.

placements.note: The native mount lane: proves the agent resolves the definition the realm installed. Imported by the glue at module load.
The pre-execute/guard port: the ONE place a controlled call is admitted.
One physical execution, one canonical fact, joined to the admission record.
The durable JSONL ledger: authority, replay refusal and execution records.
Bridges an execution fact to the product settlement store (ADMITTED -> RUNNING -> terminal).
The ONE composition point the product calls: admission + facts + settlement over one callId.
The delivered-turn reader, extracted from the glue (2026-11-22): the glue imports it, so the shipped face must carry it.
One member's execution composition (centre + native mount + lifecycle), extracted from the glue (2026-11-22). The glue imports it, so the shipped face must carry it.
